description: Source for Get-ScubaHelp and docs/misc/command-selection-matrix.md. One entry per user-facing command.

commands.name: New-SCuBAConfig
commands.summary: Generates a blank or pre-seeded config YAML from the command line.
commands.useWhen: You want a template fast, or you are scripting config creation in a pipeline.
commands.why: Zero UI, fully automatable - the quickest way to a valid starting config.

commands.name: Start-SCuBAConfigApp
commands.summary: WPF UI to build, validate, and export a config YAML (and optionally run ScubaGear).
commands.useWhen: You are authoring or editing a config by hand and want validation, pickers, and live YAML preview.
commands.why: Catches bad policy IDs and product names before they cost you a failed run; friendliest on-ramp for new users.

commands.name: Start-SCuBAConfigAnalyzer
commands.summary: WPF companion that runs (or reads) an assessment, then shows which exclusions your config needs and why.
commands.useWhen: A control failed and you need the root cause plus the exact users/groups to exclude.
commands.why: Turns raw failures into a ready-to-use exclusion config - closes the loop between 'it failed' and 'here is the fix'.

commands.name: Show-SCuBABaselinePolicyViewer
commands.summary: Read-only UI to browse every baseline policy and its rationale.
commands.useWhen: You need to look up what a policy ID means without opening markdown.
commands.why: Fast reference while you configure or triage - no scanning, no auth, just the baselines.
commands.online: No (can pull baselines from GitHub if asked)

commands.name: Invoke-SCuBADiff
commands.summary: Offline compare of two ScubaResults.json files into JSON, CSV, and HTML deltas.
commands.useWhen: You want to prove what changed between two runs (before/after a fix, or tenant vs. tenant).
commands.why: Evidence of progress or regression without re-scanning; fully offline, no tenant contact.

commands.name: Invoke-SCuBA
commands.summary: The main event - assesses your tenant against the baselines and writes JSON and HTML reports.
commands.useWhen: Any time you want a fresh, full assessment.
commands.why: This is ScubaGear; everything else supports this command.

commands.name: Invoke-SCuBACached
commands.summary: Re-runs the Rego/report step against already-exported provider data (flat output folder).
commands.useWhen: You are iterating on config or rego and do not want to re-hit the tenant each time.
commands.why: Fast dev/test loop; export provider data once, re-evaluate many times.

commands.name: Disconnect-SCuBATenant
commands.summary: Tears down the Graph/EXO/etc. sessions ScubaGear opened.
commands.useWhen: You are done, or need a clean auth state before switching tenants.
commands.why: Prevents stale or leaked sessions from bleeding into the next run.

commands.name: Install-ScubaDependencies
commands.useWhen: First-time setup, or after a version bump changes requirements.
commands.why: Nothing runs until dependencies are present; this is step one.

commands.name: Install-OPAforSCuBA
commands.summary: Downloads the OPA/Rego executable ScubaGear evaluates policies with.
commands.useWhen: First-time setup, or OPA is missing or outdated.
commands.why: No OPA, no policy evaluation - required for any assessment.

commands.name: Get-ScubaGearDependencyStatus
commands.summary: Reports which modules and OPA are present and at what version.
commands.useWhen: A run failed and you suspect a missing or mismatched dependency.
commands.why: Diagnose environment problems before blaming the config.

commands.name: Update-ScubaGear
commands.summary: Updates the ScubaGear module to the latest published version.
commands.useWhen: You want the newest baselines, fixes, and tooling.
commands.why: Keeps you current with evolving M365 baselines.
